summary.name: Udacity AI Nanodegree
summary.one_liner: An advanced, subscription-based online Nanodegree program from Udacity teaching AI fundamentals such as search, logic, planning, optimization, and probabilistic models through four Python projects.
use_cases: Learning classical AI search and planning techniques
Building a Sudoku solver in Python
Implementing minimax and alpha-beta game agents
Tagging parts of speech with a hidden Markov model
Preparing for an AI engineer career
summary.what_it_does: The program covers AI fundamentals including logic, search, and optimization for building autonomous agents that reason and solve problems. It includes four projects: a Sudoku solver using constraint propagation and search, a forward-planning agent using symbolic logic and automated planning, an adversarial game-playing agent using minimax and alpha-beta pruning, and part-of-speech tagging with a hidden Markov model and Viterbi algorithm. The page lists 36 skills, 8 courses, 35 lessons, and 4 projects, with prerequisites including intermediate Python and basic data structures. Projects are reviewed by industry professionals, and the page mentions career coaching and program certificates as part of the subscription.
notable: Four hands-on Python AI projects, including Sudoku solver and game-playing agent
Project submissions reviewed by industry professionals
Taught by instructors including Sebastian Thrun, Thad Starner, and Peter Norvig
caveats: Subscription billed monthly, with access to the program requiring a paid plan as implied by the subscription listing
Rated Advanced and requires prior Python and data structures knowledge
Salary and career outcome figures are stated by Udacity and are not independently verified
